children: Board-certified orthodontist Brandon J. Hagan, DMD, brings more than a decade of regional experience to a new practice serving children, teens and adults.

UPPER MARLBORO, MD / ACCESS Newswire / September 2, 2026 / Southern Maryland Orthodontic Studio opened its Upper Marlboro practice in August, 2026, and is now accepting new patients at 5020 Brown Station Rd #130, Upper Marlboro, MD 20772.
The office combines advanced orthodontic technology with the serene, tranquil atmosphere Dr. Hagan envisioned for the patient experience.

Dr. Hagan is a board-certified orthodontist with more than a decade of experience treating patients in Southern Maryland and the Washington, D.C. region. Southern Maryland Orthodontic Studio provides orthodontic care for children, teens and adults, with treatment options that include metal braces, clear ceramic braces, clear aligners and Invisalign® treatment. Patients work directly with Dr. Hagan from their initial consultation through progress appointments and their final visit.

"When I decided to open Southern Maryland Orthodontic Studio, I had a very clear picture of how I wanted patients to feel when they walked through the door," Dr. Hagan said. "I wanted the office to feel calm and welcoming, and I wanted patients to know we would take the time to listen and care for them as individuals. That vision shaped everything - from the space itself to the way our team serves each family."

Dr. Hagan earned his Doctor of Dental Medicine degree from the Medical University of South Carolina and completed his residency in Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics at MedStar Washington Hospital Center in 2015. He is a Diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics.

The office is located in Marlborough Village Center near the intersection of Brown Station Road and Old Marlboro Pike. Southern Maryland Orthodontic Studio serves Upper Marlboro and surrounding Maryland communities, including Bowie, Clinton, Mitchellville, Fort Washington and Waldorf. Prospective patients can learn about consultation availability through the practice contact page or by calling 301-327-1223.

Southern Maryland Orthodontic Studio is an orthodontic practice in Upper Marlboro, Maryland, led by Brandon J. Hagan, DMD, a board-certified orthodontist. The practice provides individualized orthodontic care for children, teens and adults. Southern Maryland Orthodontic Studio is located at 5020 Brown Station Rd #130, Upper Marlboro, MD 20772. Learn more at https://southernmarylandorthodontics.com/.
